subject: Re: JauntBank request — KMS continuity & crypto evidence deliverable
messages:
From: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@jauntbank.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@jauntbank.com; security.ops@jauntbank.com
Date: 2027-04-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: KMS continuity evidence & CAIQ follow-up (JauntBank)

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our SOC/InfoSec team is preparing the CAIQ/SIG pack for JauntBank's vendor review and needs a short, focused evidence packet that covers cross-region KMS continuity and the operational controls around HSM-backed keys. Key asks:

- Proof that customer-managed keys (BYOK) can be pinned and rotated without downtime across US regions.
- HSM attestation for the signing pods (latest attestation cert).
- Representative rotation logs showing operator separation and emergency revocation flow.
- Retention and zeroize proof for revoked keys (how long artifacts are kept).

Can you deliver a compact manifest and attach the HSM attestation PDF? Procurement will need the artifact by EOD Friday (2027-04-09). If you need clarification on scope, security.ops is CC'd.

Appreciate it — Laura

Laura Jensen
Head of Vendor Risk — JauntBank
laura.jensen@jauntbank.com
+1 415 555 0192

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@jauntbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; procurement@jauntbank.com; security.ops@jauntbank.com
Date: 2027-04-04T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS continuity evidence & CAIQ follow-up (JauntBank)

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a compact evidence bundle that maps to CAIQ/SIG controls for key management and continuity. Quick clarifying questions so we scope it correctly:

1) BYOK scope: do you need the full BYOK key-wrapping recipe (derivation/nonce exchanges) or just the operational handoff manifest showing wrap/unwrap timestamps?
2) Cross-region continuity: are you focusing specifically on failover (active-to-active) or on replication+failback procedures (active-standby)?
3) Rotation logs: would a 48-hour sliding sample (operator actions + signed audit entries) suffice, or do you need a longer retention window for the sample?

Planned deliverables if this matches your ask:
- redwood_kms_continuity_manifest_20270404.csv — compact index mapping controls to artifacts
- hsm-attestation-2026-11.pdf — vendor-signed HSM attestation (redacted serials)
- rotation-window-log-sample-202703.zip — 48h operator action sample, audit-chain and signatures
- short README that describes zeroize/retention policy and SLOs for BYOK handoffs

If that works I'll coordinate with Marissa and Karthik to assemble and send the bundle by Thursday EOD to give you time for review before procurement.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-04T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: FW: JauntBank request — KMS continuity & crypto evidence deliverable

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Jaunt's ask. Can you split work as follows:

- Marissa: assemble continuity_manifest CSV and README that maps each CAIQ/SIG control to the item in our bundle. Include brief notes on cross-region failover (active-active routing + KV cache warmup) and quantified RTO/RPO for pinned BYOK keys. Keep entries short — procurement reviewers prefer an index file.
- Karthik: pull the HSM attestation PDF (latest vendor cert), redact serials as usual, and produce the 48h rotation-window sample (include operator IDs, signed audit entries, and a short narrative for emergency revocation steps). Ensure operator separation evidence is present (two-person approval snapshots).

Delivery target: assemble attachments by 2027-04-08 17:00 PT so I can do a quick quality pass and send to Laura on 4/9 morning. Flag any blockers ASAP.

On a related note, call out any evidence that we cannot share (full unredacted keys, raw KVCACHE dumps) so I can note exceptions in the README.

Thanks — Soojin

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Laura Jensen <laura.jensen@jauntbank.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; procurement@jauntbank.com; security.ops@jauntbank.com
Date: 2027-04-05T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: KMS continuity evidence & CAIQ follow-up (JauntBank) — bundle attached

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the patience — attached is a compact evidence bundle mapped to the CAIQ/SIG controls you called out. Summary of contents below. If you'd like a 30-minute walkthrough of the artifacts we can set up time later this week.

Attachments included (stubs):
- redwood_kms_continuity_manifest_20270404.csv (CSV index) — maps controls to specific artifacts, with short notes on RTO/RPO and failover behavior for pinned BYOK keys across us-west/us-east.
- hsm-attestation-2026-11.pdf (PDF) — vendor-signed attestation for the HSM appliances used by Redwood (redacted serials); contains FIPS and firmware versions.
- rotation-window-log-sample-202703.zip (ZIP) — 48-hour sample including operator approval snapshots, signed audit-chain entries, and emergency revocation sequence (redacted identities where required).

Key points called out in the README (attached to the manifest):
- BYOK handoff: We support customer-managed wrap keys (BYOK). The manifest documents the wrap/unwrap handshake and indicates that key pinning is sessionless (no downtime) — we hot-rotate wrapped keys and coordinate cache warmup; expected tokenized request latency impact is sub-second under normal load.
- Cross-region continuity: Active-active routing between us-west and us-east with automatic KV cache warmup and prefix caching; failover time measured at median 8s under test, 95th at 23s (testback in manifest).
- Rotation & operator controls: Two-person operator approval enforced for all production rewraps or emergency revocations; rotation audit entries are signed and retained per our standard retention policy.
- Zeroize/retention: Key material (unwrapped plaintext keys) is never persisted; wrapped key artifacts and audit entries are retained for 90 days by default (configurable via contract). Zeroize is immediate on revocation; we provide signed zeroize receipts where required.

Redaction notes: As usual we have redacted hardware serials and customer-identifying data from logs. Full unredacted logs are available under a SCIF review if JauntBank needs forensic-level detail.

Delivery link (temporary access): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/jauntbank/kms-continuity-manifest — will expire in 14 days.

If this meets your needs I'll follow up with a short walkthrough and provide a DocuSign link for any contract addenda you need.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Security Evidence Lead | Redwood Inference
